senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; preced. art.) security, ease, contentment, happiness.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 84">Gen. R. s. 84</cite> <he>בשעה … יושבין בש׳ וכ׳</he> when the righteous dwell at ease, and desire to remain at ease in this world, Satan comes &c.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 4:15">Ab. IV, 15</cite> <he>אין … משַׁלְוַת הרשעים וכ׳</he> it is beyond our power to understand why the wicked are at ease, or why the righteous suffer.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 49">Gen. R. s. 49</cite> <he>עיקר שַׁלְוָותָהּ של סדום וכ׳</he> the real undisturbed prosperity of Sodom lasted only &c.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 10:9">Gen. R. s. 10</cite>, end, v. <cite ref="U00039"><he>שַׁאֲנָן</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 12">Num. R. s. 12<sup>3</sup></cite> <he>רק בעיניך תביט שַׁלְוָתְךָ</he> ‘thou shalt behold with thine eyes’ (<cite ref="Psalms 91:8">Ps. XCI, 8</cite>) thy happiness.
